verdict.rationale: Cake documents a separate My Cake Portal where employees and investors view their individual holdings, with admin-controlled visibility. Stakeholder portals are included even on the free plan, and linked share certificates are accessible there. Nothing shows what the portal displays beyond holdings, and the only modelling evidence is admin-side round and dilution modelling. Missing for 10: evidence that the portal shows vesting progress and strike price, employee-facing exit or outcome value modelling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
